fine_lines.title: because vs even though
fine_lines.explanation_ar: because تعطي السبب. even though تعني «رغم أن» وتعرض شيئًا متوقعًا لم يحدث.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Because gives a reason. Even though means 'although': it shows a surprising contrast.

examples.sentence: We can't train because it's too cold.
Even though you're trying hard, you're bad at it.

fine_lines.title: as soon as vs as long as
fine_lines.explanation_ar: as soon as = فور / بمجرد (للوقت). as long as = بشرط أن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: As soon as = right after (time). As long as = only if (condition).

examples.sentence: As soon as I get home, I'll do it.
That's great, as long as the trainer understands speed walking.

expressions.meaning_en: Used to ask someone to do something or to stop being difficult.
You must work hard to get good results.
expressions.example: The training is hard, but no pain, no gain!
Everyone is here. Let's get started!

expressions.meaning_en: It doesn't matter; stop talking about it.
expressions.example: You didn't read it? Forget it.

expressions.phrase: It's part of who I am.
expressions.meaning_en: It is very important to me and my identity.
expressions.example: I love reading. It's part of who I am.

grammar.title: Adverb clauses
grammar.explanation_ar: جملة الظرف (adverb clause) جزء من الجملة يخبرنا متى أو لماذا أو كيف أو بأي شرط. تبدأ بكلمات مثل: when, before, after, since, as soon as (للوقت)، because (للسبب)، if, as long as (للشرط)، even though (للتناقض). هي جملة تابعة لا تكتمل وحدها، فيجب أن تأتي مع جملة رئيسية. إذا بدأنا بها نضع فاصلة: Because it's cold, we can't train. وإذا جاءت في الآخر فلا فاصلة غالبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: An adverb clause tells when, why, how or under what condition. It starts with words like when, before, after, since, as soon as (time), because (reason), if, as long as (condition), even though (contrast). It is a dependent clause, so it needs a main clause. Put a comma if it comes first: Because it's cold, we can't train.
examples: Since I've been working in an office, my speed walking has been slower.
After you fill out an online application, they will match you to a trainer.
We can't train today because it's too cold.
Even though you're trying hard, you're really bad at parkour.

questions.question: We can't go out ____ it's raining.
____ he is tired, he keeps walking.
____ I get home, I'll call you. (right after)
questions.explanation_en: As soon as means right after.

questions.question: An adverb clause is:
choices: a dependent clause that needs a main clause
questions.explanation_ar: جملة الظرف تابعة وتحتاج جملة رئيسية.
questions.explanation_en: It is dependent; it needs a main clause.

questions.question: 'Out of shape' means:
questions.explanation_ar: out of shape = غير لائق بدنيًا.
questions.explanation_en: Out of shape means not fit.

questions.question: You write your information on a form. You ____ the form.
questions.explanation_en: Fill out means write information in a form.

questions.question: 'No pain, no gain' means:
choices: You must work hard to get results.

questions.question: You can come ____ you are quiet. (only if)
questions.explanation_en: As long as means only if.

questions.question: A cup you win as a prize is a ____.
questions.explanation_en: A trophy is a prize cup.

questions.question: Which sentence has the comma in the right place?
choices: Because, it's cold we stay home.
Because it's cold we, stay home.
Because it's cold, we stay home.
Because it's, cold we stay home.
questions.explanation_ar: نضع الفاصلة بعد جملة الظرف عندما تأتي أولًا.
questions.explanation_en: Put the comma after the adverb clause when it comes first.
